High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is an application seeking to quash chargesheet arising out of Crime No.0278/2023 registered
by non-applicant No.1 for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 read with
Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2), 27, 30(2)(a) and 59 of Food Safety and
Standard Act.
3. Issue notice to the non-applicants returnable after eight weeks.

4. Mr. A.M. Chutke, learned A.P.P. waives notice for non-applicant No.1.
5.
In the meantime, the trial Court shall not proceed till the next date of hearing.
Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 26/04/2024 15:00:22
